dedupe_keys.name: global lakes and wetlands database version 2 glwd v2

description: The Global Lakes and Wetlands Database version 2 contains a continuous global map of inland surface waters divided into 33 waterbody and wetland types, representing 18.2 million square kilometres of wetlands as the maximum non-overlapping extent of aquatic ecosystems over the contemporary period 1990 to 2020. It was developed by Lehner and colleagues within HydroSHEDS by harmonising the best available ground and satellite sources, and supersedes GLWD version 1 of 2004. Coverage is global at a grid resolution of 15 arc-seconds, about 500 m at the equator; the data give the dominant class per cell plus 33 layers of sub-cell fractions. Files are downloadable from Figshare as GeoTIFF and file geodatabase archives of about 0.9 to 1.6 GB each, with technical documentation, and an interactive web viewer shows the main classes with Ramsar sites. The licence is CC BY 4.0 and access is free. Caveats: it is a static composite, not a time series, class boundaries depend on the harmonised sources, and the coarse grid misses small urban wetlands. It supports green and blue infrastructure inventories, flood storage and wetland-based adaptation studies; related records are the JRC Global Surface Water, the Global Mangrove Watch, WDPA and the Global Flood Database.
